startup_seconds.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. The runs read 0.985, 0.973 and 0.989 s, the medians of their three launches (1.608, 0.893, 0.985; 1.560, 0.973, 0.947; 1.652, 0.989, 0.956 s), the first of each paying for a cold page cache. Against 0.9 s on the Debug build, that is 0.09 s later, within the runs' spread of 0.02 s and the first launches' cold cache. The ceiling is unchanged, about four times the September median, which is what the startup probes in docs/development.md use, because a shared runner's speed is not its own. It holds at 33% of the ceiling.

startup_lived_in_seconds.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. Process start to the first buffer on the toplevel's surface with the lived-in profile, file-cache cold, median of three launches. The profile is #618's reader's shape at about its size, 403 MiB: two Spaces, three open tabs, closed and put-away tabs, 106 visits, both filter lists, an 83 MiB extension and the engine's HTTP cache, Cache Storage and IndexedDB; the page cache is dropped before each launch. The runs read 1.926, 1.911 and 1.611 s, the medians of their three launches (the launches within a run agree to 0.04 s; the runs differ by 0.3 s). Against 1.62 s on the Debug build. The ceiling is unchanged, about four times the first recording, as the startup ceiling is, because a shared runner's speed is not its own.

memory_mebibytes.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. Proportional set size of the whole process tree, one Space, one page: 601.6, 592.0 and 603.7 MiB at the first Space of the spaces step, and 589.92, 590.82 and 591.59 MiB in the memory step, the median of which is recorded. The Debug build read 502.49 MiB on 2026-10-29, so the build readers run reads 88 MiB more (#889), which the issue put at about 90. The split is the same in all three runs: browser 471.1, 472.4 and 473.8 MiB, renderer 74.0 to 74.3, zygotes 42.1 to 43.2 and session bus 1.7 MiB. The Debug build's renderer, zygotes and bus read the same (#884's run 40919000819: browser 373.5, renderer 74.8, zygotes 42.4, bus 1.7), so the difference is in the browser's own process. Why is left open: the release preset compiles the QML into the binary where the Debug build loads it from source, and optimises, but no measurement here separates the two. Against 481.45 MiB, recorded on 2026-09-15 on the Debug build in the shared arch-linux job on Arch's qt6-webengine 6.11.2-1. About 50 MiB of the Debug build's growth since 2026-09-28 is in the browser process (#884), in Qt Quick's objects, textures and layers the chrome makes as it starts, and #889 put the release build's growth over the same weeks at about 80. The ceiling is unchanged at twice the first recording, as the frozen-tab probe's is: it now holds 61% of the ceiling, against 52% on the Debug build.

space_mebibytes.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. The first recording, 74.18 MiB, averaged a second Space that cost the engine 177 MiB; it now costs 41 to 45 MiB, so the average is two fifths of it. The ceiling is unchanged, twice the first recording.

frozen_growth_mebibytes.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. What an away Space's page goes on taking once frozen, over ten seconds, against ADR 0033. It is read from the engine's processes, the browser's own left out, because on CI the browser process takes a step of about 6 MiB at no predictable moment (#467). The runs read 0.47, 0.51 and 0.32 MiB, against 0.44 MiB on the Debug build and 0.02 MiB in September. Tighter than the others on purpose: the same page grew 29.9 MiB in the six seconds it was on show in all three runs, and a page left running while away is throttled to a megabyte a second. The ceiling is unchanged.

pageload_fresh_hosts_milliseconds.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. What Content blocking adds to a page of 40 images from 40 hosts it has never seen, the median with blocking on minus the median with the site switched off, ten loads each: 166.9 against 156.0 ms, 178.8 against 154.8 ms and 179.9 against 158.0 ms, so 11.0, 24.0 and 21.85 ms (22.45 ms on the Debug build, 18.2 ms on 6.11.2-3). This holds CNAME uncloaking's lookups as well as the rule check, the Refusal tally and the refused-request list. Secure DNS off. The hosts resolve through dnsmasq on the container's resolver, with CNAME chains, not host-resolver rules. Procedural cosmetic filtering is measured separately under #402. The ceiling is unchanged, four times the first recording's difference.

pageload_known_hosts_milliseconds.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. The same for 40 images from 4 hosts resolved on the warm-up loads: 186.4 against 185.7 ms, 181.6 against 181.4 ms and 187.1 against 186.8 ms, so 0.75, 0.3 and 0.35 ms (2.9 ms on the Debug build, 4.0 ms on 6.11.2-3). A difference this small is below what the runner can tell apart. Four times the first recording's difference is 16 ms, under the 20 ms floor, which is the ceiling and is unchanged.

pageload_procedural_hosts_milliseconds.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. live_tabs_idle_cpu_percent.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. telemetry_background_cpu_percent.note: Re-recorded on 2026-10-29 on CI's runner on the release build, the `release` preset the package ships, rather than the ci preset's Debug build the earlier recordings were taken on (#889), against Omaweb's engine, omaweb-qtwebengine 6.11.3-1, with the branch at ca208d3f: the median of three budget-job runs (run 40927181080, attempts 1 to 3), all on an AMD EPYC 7763. What choosing the Telemetry Scene adds to the process tree's CPU while the reader is on a page, so no Start page draws: its sampler, which reads /proc and /sys four times a second so a new tab's graphs are full (#814). The tree's CPU over 30 s on a page with Telemetry chosen, less the same with no Scene, as a share of one core: 0.37 less 0.23, 0.37 less 0.30 and 0.47 less 0.30%, so 0.13, 0.07 and 0.17% (0.13% on the Debug build). The 0.37% the first recording replaced was a laptop's. Timed alone, a sample costs about 0.1 ms, 0.04% of a core at four a second. The ceiling is unchanged at 2%, as the idle tree's is, because a difference this small moves with whatever else the machine is doing.
